scam_info.notes: IMDA anti-scam hub (sitemap lastmod 2026-11-04). The content loads via JavaScript from a backend not documented for public use, so it was NOT fetched (per ground rules). Known measures (from search results and the MDDI hub): Full SSIR regime from 31 Jan 2023, where unregistered alphanumeric sender IDs are labelled "Likely-SCAM"; blocking of spoofed +65 international calls; "+" prefix on overseas calls; telcos blocking scam SMS and malicious links since 2019.
